mapper.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(C.COURSE_NO) AS COURSE_NO, TO_CHAR(C.SYSMANA_NO) AS SYSMANA_NO, C.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(C.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, C.TRAIN_TYPE_NO, C.COURSE_NAME_CODE, C.COURSE_NUMBER, C.REMARK FROM EDU_COURSE_MANAGER C
mapper.select:
WHERE C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.ACTIVITY = '1'
AND C.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT SC.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE SC WHERE SC.PARENT_CODE_NO = #{trainDiffCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND C.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE = #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(C.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
ORDER BY C.CREATE_DATE DESC
WHERE C.COURSE_NO = #{courseNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT MAX(COURSE_NUMBER) FROM EDU_COURSE_MANAGER WHERE CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND COURSE_NUMBER LIKE #{trainTypeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '-%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_COURSE_MANAGER (COURSE_NO, TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, COURSE_NAME_CODE, COURSE_NUMBER, REMARK, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, TRAIN_TYPE_NO, SYSMANA_NO) VALUES (EDU_COUR_MANA_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseNumber, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1', SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainTypeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sysmanaNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B SET B.COURSE_NAME_CODE = #{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE B.PLAN_NO IN (SELECT P.PLAN_NO FROM EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P WHERE P.COURSE_NO = #{courseNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
